title: HaloMaps hotspot registry
description: Curated road corridors where drivers face elevated vehicle-crime risk. Corridors are LINEAR traces of a road. There is deliberately no polygon or area type — see CONTRIBUTING.md rule 1c. validate.py is the authoritative checker; this schema exists for editor support and third-party consumers.

schema_version.description: Bumped only for a breaking change to this shape.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug. Unique across the file; used to withdraw a corridor as a unit.

road.description: Shown VERBATIM to the driver. Names a ROAD, never a settlement (rule 2). A place name may bound a stretch, e.g. 'N7 between Melkbosstrand and Killarney Gardens'.

risk.description: Also selects the tier: >= 0.5 avoids and warns; < 0.5 warns only.

rationale.description: Why this corridor is listed, in the curator's own words.

sources.description: Published evidence. An entry nobody can check is an opinion, not a dataset.

reviewed_on.description: When a human last confirmed the entry. Must not be in the future.

corridor.description: The road's shape as [latitude, longitude] pairs, bounded to South Africa.
